name: linkedin-animated-infographics
description: Create LinkedIn visual stories with evidence checks, narrative taste, verified logo and mascot sourcing, reference-aware concepting, perception preflight, still-first critique, disciplined motion, targeted visual repair, and focused pre-publish QA.
starter_prompts: Run this in autopilot and turn the idea into an animated LinkedIn infographic with a strong visual hook and useful aha moment.
Create an Info-story from this material and choose the best story shape before designing it.
Review this finished LinkedIn infographic and tell me what must be fixed before publishing.
Use the named AI tool identities in this brief and source their official visual assets correctly.
Prepare this verified demo for the community gallery and ask before publishing anything.
release_notes: Version 3.7.0 strengthens ChatGPT/Codex visual-story production before publication. It adds a first-class narrative-taste contract with Reader questions, beat-to-visual mapping, turn/payoff logic, bounded demo-inspired mechanism transfer, and explicit rejection of list-to-card storytelling. Identity resolution now prefers exact user-supplied and original-owner assets, supports commit/blob/SHA-256-pinned Vibe SVGs platform/tool logos, keeps identity geometry/colors/wordmarks/aspect ratio locked, and prevents Vibe SVGs communityArtwork mascots from being represented as official. Six Sister Plugin URLs are carried only as optional capability-safe handoffs with no hidden dependency or inferred invocation. The release also preserves blocking perception preflight, severity-aware visual-slop pressure, targeted repair routing, final-frame completion checks, capability-negotiated autopilot execution, intentional render-safe typography, deterministic visual-intelligence capsules, and the self-contained Skills-only OpenAI runtime that isolates repository demos and Claude worker internals from the public package.
external_prerequisites: Apps Management write access in the OpenAI organization used for publishing
Verified individual or business developer identity for the publisher
Manual country or region availability selection in the OpenAI Platform submission form
Manual OpenAI Platform submission followed by OpenAI review and publisher-triggered publication after approval
